items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Joe Howard was a trumpet player, and he was a good musician.

ctx.x: Calverette. Mm-hmm. And he stayed in Tom Anderson for a long time. And he left on Tom Anderson. He went on to boat. Mm-hmm. To feed him off. Mm-hmm. Joe Howard. Joe Howard. Joe was a little, a little, a little, a little, a little. Joe Howard was a trumpet player, and he was a good musician. Did many of the trumpet players help you out on drums when you were playing? Mm-hmm .
Mm-hmm . drums when you were playing if you made a mistake? You know I think Octave told me the trumpet player sometimes would kind of straighten him out when he was young.
